findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice mcqs for Chapter 3 in the same format as Chapter 1 (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 136 questions numbered 1-136; by section: 3.1 40, 3.2 30, 3.3 27, 3.4 11, 3.5 11, 3.6 17. Book corrections followed: friction provides the centripetal force (not energy); a = Rω² in the spaceship is a centripetal (not angular) acceleration; low-orbit period about 85 min (not 5060 s); Example 3.4 orbital speed 1.01 km s⁻¹ and period 28.0 days.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
